fusions.name: Glancing Bound
fusions.desc: Swipes an enemy up to 3 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Startling Leap
fusions.desc: Springs straight up and lands hard, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Twig-Snap Bolt
fusions.desc: Springs 5 tiles in the direction you face and increases your movement speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Alarm Reflex
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 15 stamina at once. Once every 20 seconds.
